cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
what_is_included: With up to 8hp Mercury outboards and stable, flat bottoms, our skiffs are easy to operate and perfect for family fishing outings or the serious bay angler alike. Rentals for fishing only– Fishing Licenses & Gear required for rental. Don’t have your own gear or license? Our Coronado & Mission Bay locations sell & rent poles and tackle. Licenses sold on site as well.
